title: G-ring
statement: A commutative ring $R$ is a *G-ring* if $R$ is Noetherian and for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset R$ the ring map $R_{\mathfrak p}\to(R_{\mathfrak p})^\wedge$ from the localization to its $\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$-adic completion is regular, i.e. flat with geometrically regular fibre rings (Stacks More on Algebra, Definition 07GH and Definition 07BZ of a regular ring map); equivalently every local ring $R_{\mathfrak p}$ has geometrically regular formal fibres.
